items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Also in the same band was a fine guitar player... And, of course, there were three of us trombone players and I mentioned previously that two of these guys have passed away now. And that would be Billy Franklin and Louis Taylor.

ctx.x: No, we didn't. And this -- when her book came out I hadn't gotten anything else from it at that time. But, you know, it was -- I felt bad about it because, you know, if somebody do that to do and you don't know him, you don't feel so bad. But for a friend, you know, a guy that you consider a friend -- because I was his best man at his wedding, you know, when he married his first wife, Dorothy, you know.

In fact, when she died later -- years later, after all this problem happened, I went out -- myself and Louis Taylor, another trombone player, and we played a song with organ for -- at her funeral, you know. But you know, I couldn't hold it against her. She didn't do nothing to me, you know. But these things happen in this business, you know.
But you had been working with him though for so long.
